name: play-store-aso-competitor-intelligence
displayName: Google Play Store ASO & Competitor Intelligence Studio
description: Autonomous Google Play Store ASO competitor scraping, gap analysis, and conversion engineering studio. Ingests target and competitor package IDs, extracts live store metadata, performs head-to-head keyword and feature gap audits, generates policy-compliant metadata, drafts corridor Custom Store Listings (CSL), synthesizes 4-Pillar Growth Playbooks, and exports executive .docx & markdown audit artifacts directly to the user's Downloads folder.
author: Antigravity Agentic Studio

commands.name: audit-competitor
commands.description: Execute head-to-head comparative ASO gap audit between target app and competitor

commands.name: scrape-app
commands.description: Scrape live public metadata from Google Play Store web listing with 1 req/sec rate limit

commands.name: export-docx
commands.description: Compile comparative ASO matrix, vulnerability analysis, and takeover blueprint into styled executive Word document

commands.name: generate-artifact
commands.description: Generate structured markdown audit artifact defining user input parameters and takeover blueprint

rules: Strict Title Limit: Title must never exceed 30 characters and must fuse brand name with root search query.
Strict Short Description Limit: Short description must never exceed 80 characters.
Prohibited Superlatives Policy: Metadata must omit all banned claims ('Best', 'Free', 'Top', '#1', 'No.1').
Head-to-Head Gap Audit: Every competitive analysis must contrast keyword counts, install velocities, ratings, and feature differentiators.
Corridor CSL Invariant: High-volume international diaspora corridors (KSA, UAE, Qatar) must receive dedicated Custom Store Listings.
Executive Word Delivery: Every full audit must compile and export an executive .docx report to the user's Downloads directory.
Growth Playbook Invariant: Every audit must synthesize the 4-Pillar Organic & Viral Growth Playbook.
